"Patient evening reminders about bedding supplies"
Start here

Traveling with pets can feel smoother when the basics are clear. This note explains the usual steps the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways asks travelers to follow before check-in.

Pet travel paperwork is best gathered early, then kept with your ticket details. If you are sending a bird, the combined pet-and-crate limit applies as shown in the record below. Keep carriers secure, well ventilated, and easy for staff to inspect. Soft bedding, a familiar toy, and a calm routine can help your companion settle in.

If your trip includes a reptile, bring the health certificate that matches the journey rules shown below. Make sure the enclosure is tidy and closed properly, with no loose items that could shift during travel. A clear label on the carrier helps crews handle the animal with care.

For cats, the travel fee appears below in the record for this article. Plan ahead so you can confirm booking details before you reach the airport. A sturdy carrier with enough room to stand and turn is a simple way to keep your pet comfortable. Travelers like Leila Wong and Caleb Kaur often keep a spare absorbent pad in the bag for small accidents, which can make the trip easier for everyone.

If your pet has special feeding needs, pack supplies in the carry bag where you can reach them easily. Staff can guide you on check-in steps, but they may also need to review the carrier and documents before acceptance. When in doubt, keep the pet's comfort and safety ahead of convenience.

For the smoothest experience, arrive prepared, stay patient, and check all paperwork before leaving home. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
